scheme_name: D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme
other_conditions: Must have completed post‑graduation for junior and senior categories
Must have a PhD for post‑doctoral category
Junior category limited to individuals up to 35 years of age
Senior category limited to individuals above 35 years of age
Only one fellowship per individual per category in a lifetime
benefits_summary: Junior fellows receive up to ₹15,000 per month for up to 2 years; senior and post‑doctoral fellows receive ₹20,000 per month (₹30,000 for full‑time research) for up to 2 years.
